title: cyclamen repandum subsp. balearicum
intro: Cyclamen repandum subsp. balearicum, commonly known as the Balearic Cyclamen, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. It is native to the Balearic Islands and is known for its heart-shaped leaves and vibrant, delicate flowers. The health benefits of Cyclamen repandum subsp. balearicum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects.
